name: zinput_global_state_static_init
description: zInput::GlobalStateStaticInit constructs the static global-state storage by invoking zInput_GlobalState::Constructor.

functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4719f0 loads the static global-state storage address and tail-jumps to zInput_GlobalState::Constructor.
